segments.name: Agribusiness
segments.description: Merchandises and manages logistics of physical commodities and manufactures, distributes and retails agricultural and plant nutrient products for producers and end users.
segments.evidence: The Agribusiness segment is a diversified business focusing on capturing profits through relationships with agricultural producers and end users as both a supplier and customer.

segments.name: Renewables
segments.description: Produces, purchases and sells ethanol and co-products from four ethanol plants and merchandises ethanol, co-products and other biofuels.
segments.evidence: The Renewables segment produces, purchases and sells ethanol and co-products.

revenueModel.text: The company earns merchandising margins and elevation fees buying and selling commodities, plus fees for grain marketing, risk management and origination services, and sells ethanol, co-products and nutrients to customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The business also offers a number of unique grain marketing, risk management and origination services to its customers and ethanol plants within the Renewables segment for which it collects fees.

changes.text: In 2025 the former Trade segment was combined with the former Nutrient & Industrial segment to form the new Agribusiness segment.
changes.evidence: As a result, the former Trade segment was combined with the former Nutrient & Industrial segment in the newly formed Agribusiness segment along with several smaller business lines being moved between the Agribusiness and Renewables segments.

changes.text: In 2024 substantially all of ELEMENT's assets were sold after the Company deconsolidated the subsidiary in 2023.
changes.evidence: Substantially all of the ELEMENT's assets were sold on January 31, 2024, see Note 17 of the Consolidated Financial Statements for more information.
